page.content:
Yawden was the nemesis of the planeswalker Arzakon, who attacked Shandalar. Though little is known of Yawden, it is assumed he is just as evil and aggressive as Arzakon.

page.overview:
Who is Yawden?

Yawden was the nemesis of the planeswalker Arzakon, who attacked Shandalar. Though little is known of Yawden, it is assumed he is just as evil and aggressive as Arzakon.
